business_problem: Officeworks wanted to automate finance, merchandise, and other back-office processes without adding disconnected RPA tooling or relying on staff to monitor work only during office hours.
solution_summary: Officeworks wanted to automate finance, merchandise, and other back-office processes without adding disconnected RPA tooling or relying on staff to monitor work only during office hours. Officeworks implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Workflow Data Fabric, RPA Hub, and Document Intelligence. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context; RPA Hub executes repetitive bot tasks; Document Intelligence extracts structured data from documents and emails. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by RPA Hub and Document Intelligence before ServiceNow AI Platform and Workflow Data Fabric routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.

solution_components.name: Workflow Data Fabric
solution_components.role: Connects operational data across systems and powers automation with shared context.

solution_components.name: RPA Hub
solution_components.role: Runs robotic process automations for repetitive back-office tasks.

solution_components.name: Document Intelligence
solution_components.role: Extracts structured data from documents and emails for downstream workflows.
